external CDN being online (plan §1.7, do-not-do list). Unknown values stay
null and MUST NOT be read as 0. Values here are generic published free/base
tiers, NOT this deployment's real per-account quota — the owner's real
override, higher authority) and, at runtime, by the provider's own
x-ratelimit-* headers (highest authority, owned by the limiter).
